mentions.name: Self-hosted Forgejo + actions runner
mentions.description: Self-hosted development infrastructure replacing GitHub and GitLab with Forgejo plus an actions runner, along with a backup plan covering documents, the Immich library, the SaaS database, and the Forgejo repositories.
mentions.source_excerpt: Lastly, I'm messing with self-hosting. I completely ditched Github and Gitlab for self hosted forgejo + actions runner. I set up proper backup plan for everything I care (documents, immich library, my SaaS DB, and the forgejo repositories).
mentions.author: skwee357
